overall_reason: A share dialog for 'Launch brief' with access 'Anyone with the link · Can view' and 'Copy link', dressed in browser-window chrome it does not need.

score.reason: T-BOLD-MOVE passes on 'Copy link', but T-REMOVE-DEVICE shows the window dots add nothing, the title 'Share handoff' is vague, and the document name sits in a box that reads as an input.

findings.title: The subject is known, not painted on
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png a small dialog carries three traffic-light dots and a centred title 'Share handoff'.
findings.after: Drop the dots; title the dialog with its action, for example 'Share Launch brief'.
findings.why: The prop makes a dialog look like a window demo and spends the title on a vague noun pair.

findings.title: App screens disappear into the task
findings.evidence: In tiles/1440-00.png 'Launch brief' sits centred in a bordered field the width of the dialog, the same shape as a text input.
findings.before: The shared document shown as an input field.
findings.after: Show the document as a label or a file chip, not a field.
findings.why: Readers may try to type into it; the object of the share reads as a control.

strengths: Access and permission are stated in plain words ('Anyone with the link', 'Can view') with one dark 'Copy link' action.
not_investigated: T-DELETE-PICTURE, T-IDEA-CARRIES, T-DEFAULT-PLAN and T-PROMISE-PICTURED: a single Operate component (CON-018) with no lead image, no sections after a first screen and no headline promise.
00-contract.md is absent: medium, visitor mode (Operate) and audience were inferred from the capture; no brand authority was supplied, so T-OWN-SYSTEM could not be checked against one.
Motion and state changes: one static frame per width only.
